items.rationale: Section 7.1.7(f) allows the first travel charge on this contractor’s invoice: one flat rate at €83 gross. The higher-band deductible applies once to the event under §§4.7 and 7.8, but its amount is not supplied, so no additional deduction is estimated.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers sealing material used in the pipe repair; one unit at €25 gross.

Sections 2.4.3(a), 7.1.7(c) and 7.1.9 cover replacement of the failed indoor supply section up to the like-for-like cost. Allow €47 gross for one metre as a standard-grade equivalent, subject to confirming compatibility with the documented repair.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers reinstating the original type of pipe insulation; one metre at €25 gross.

Section 7.1.7(g) covers the documented one-hour sign-off if it was necessary and distinct from the technician’s testing. The comparable one-hour line in Case 55 supports €110 gross, rather than the broader installation prior.

Section 7.1.8(b) excludes the contractor’s own measuring devices, even though necessary diagnostic work can be covered. The €25 estimate is conditional on proof that this was a separately eligible external hire rather than a charge for the contractor’s own device.
Sections 7.1.7(a) and (g) cover the first day’s access and pipe removal. The gross estimate is €885 for the entire nine-unit block.
Section 7.1.7(f) allows only the first travel charge on this invoice, even for separate visits. The conditional value of one otherwise eligible trip is €83 gross.
Sections 7.1.7(b) and (e) cover necessary drying and allow one flat-rate deployment per drying operation. The first deployment is estimated at €610 gross.
Section 7.1.8(b) expressly excludes contractor blades as business equipment. The conditional gross price for one blade is €12.

Sections 7.1.7(c) and 7.1.8(d) allow fittings used in the documented connection repair. The claim mentions one fitting, so payment for the full quantity is uncertain; if both were used, two at €28 give €56 gross.
Section 7.1.7(g) covers the separately documented day of fitting, testing and lagging; this is not a duplicate under §7.1.8(c). Estimate €885 gross for the whole nine-unit block.

items.description: Close and paint the disturbed wall opening
items.rationale: Sections 7.1.5 and 7.1.7(a) cover closing the necessary access opening and painting the disturbed patch. Allow €664 gross for the local repair only.

Section 7.1.7(a) covers making good the two tile rows removed for necessary pipe access, even though the strip is outside the photos. Allow €300 gross for like-for-like materials and installation on the one-metre strip, excluding the separately billed travel.

Sections 7.1.5–7.1.6 exclude matching work on undamaged surfaces; there is no evidence that matching tiles were unavailable, and the disturbed strip is already billed on line 14. The €1,540 conditional estimate values 14 m² at €110/m² gross and is not an allowance.

Sections 7.1.7(e) and 7.1.8(c) bar a second deployment charge for the same drying operation, including across trades. A separately substantiated necessary operation would be estimated at €610 gross, but none is described.
Section 7.1.7(f) allows one travel charge for this separate contractor and invoice because the tiler performed covered splashback work. Allow €83 gross for one charge.
